- High-level BCP/DR architecture diagram + recovery time objectives for control plane and customer-controlled private deployments.

3) Asks for your team
- Please confirm whether Sapling requires signed NDA before we send redacted SOC artifacts.
- Attach any vendor questionnaire you want us to start filling (I'll route internally).

I'll attach the basic SOC summary and a one-pager on IR/BCP as a starting point. If useful, propose a 30-minute security Q&A on Friday (Dec 4) to walk through the playbook.

- SOC 2 Type II report (audit window Apr 2025 - Mar 2026) — redacted PDF available; extract/controls matrix we can share without NDA.
- IR playbook excerpt (includes severity matrix, on-call escalation, and communication templates).
- BCP/DR high-level architecture diagram and RTO targets for control plane (RTO: 6 hours for core control path; RPO: 1 hour for state backups) — note: customer-managed private deployments may have different RTOs depending on topology.

- Customer notification window: we commit to notifying affected customers within 72 hours of confirmed data exposure for HIPAA-relevant incidents — we will include scope, initial mitigation steps, and a named contact.
- Full technical root-cause and remediation plan: target delivery within 5 business days for high-severity incidents; extended investigations may require up to 10 business days.

Delivery schedule (what I'll drop into the shared drive):
- Dec 3 EOD: SOC 2 extract + controls matrix (no NDA); IR playbook excerpt (redacted) ; BCP/DR architecture PNG.
- Dec 4 by 10:00 AM PST: Full redacted SOC 2 Type II report (if NDA handled) or immediately after NDA is back.
